URL: https://docs.crustdata.com/api-reference/job-apis/search-the-indexed-job-dataset
Title: Search Jobs

Description: Search Crustdata job dataset using filter conditions. Each result includes the job's details (title, category, URL, openings), the hiring company's core firmographics (basic info, headcount, followers, revenue, funding, competitors), the job location, full job description text, and metadata timestamps.
- Supports complex AND/OR filter logic, cursor-based pagination, sorting, field selection, and aggregations (count and group_by).
- Only indexed fields are filterable and sortable.

Rate limit: Default 15 requests per minute.

Method: POST
URL: https://api.crustdata.com/job/search

Auth: Bearer token (required)
Headers: x-api-version (required, e.g., "2025-11-01")

Body (application/json):
  filters: object — SearchCondition or and/or group
    Example: { field: "company.basic_info.company_id", type: "=", value: 631394 }
    Common fields:
      company.basic_info.company_id, company.basic_info.name, company.basic_info.primary_domain,
      job_details.title, job_details.url, job_details.category, job_details.openings,
      location.country, location.state, location.city, location.raw,
      metadata.date_added, metadata.updated_at
    Any indexed field from the job schema.
  cursor: string — opaque pagination cursor
  limit: integer, default 20, range 0..1000 (0 = aggregations only)
  sorts: array
    sorts.column: string
    sorts.order: asc|desc
    Example: [{ column: "metadata.date_added", order: "desc" }]
  fields: string[] — dot-notation. Top-level groups: crustdata_job_id, job_details, company, location,
    content, metadata. Nested ok (company.basic_info, company.headcount, company.funding, etc).
  aggregations: array
    type: "count" | "group_by"
    column: string
    agg: "count"
    size: integer
    Example: [{ type: "group_by", column: "company.basic_info.company_id", agg: "count", size: 5 }]

Response (200):
  job_listings: array
    - crustdata_job_id, job_details {title, url, category, openings, description, ...},
      company { basic_info, headcount, followers, revenue, funding, competitors, ... },
      location { country, state, city, raw },
      content (full job description text),
      metadata { date_added, updated_at }
  next_cursor: string | null
  total_count: integer | null
  aggregations: array (present only when request included aggregations)
    - type, column, value
